c.html: Solving Digital Transformation Challenges and Providing Strategic Solutions to Improve, Grow, and Adopt Organizational Intranet Best Practices

Our boutique consulting firm is dedicated to enhancing, extending, and delivering a refined LumApps employee experience platform to our customers. Being a LumApps Tech Partner and a long-standing LumApps SME since 2017 makes us a leading solutions partner in this space to help enterprises optimize LumApps in ways that enables continuous growth, adoption and evolution to fulfill their business' strategic goals and objectives.

nodes.html: OUR VALUED CUSTOMERS

Read Why Our
Customers are Satisfied

c.html:
PJ Marcello
Corporate Intranet Manager

We have worked with ADC for the past 2 years, and more specifically Misha for the last 3 years (1 year with LumApps). Given Misha's extensive knowledge of LumApps, he has always provided top level support into the platform. ADC has helped us with custom designs on a complete company rebrand, created custom widgets to help us improve user experience, and engaged on several other large strategic projects to improve how we utilize our intranet. I cannot recommend ADC's service enough to anyone who wants to level up the LumApps experience for their users.

Sean Young
Director of Technology

We take great pride in the quality partnerships our brand has established with the various technology companies with whom we work. Our relationship with ADC is a prime example of this. For nearly three years now, Misha and the rest of the ADC team have served as our Lumapps SMEs and development partners. I would highly recommend ADC to anyone wishing to fully leverage their experience with Lumapps. I can confidently assure you that you will not be disappointed!

Tomson Varghese
Senior Manager - Finance Transporation

Working with ADC helped our team accelerate the completion and launch of our knowledge management and training portal on a tight timeline and with limited resources. Misha's design recommendations and previous cross-industry experience was extremely useful throughout the project.
